description: Client-side script for the 'Item' doctype in ERPNext, managing item form behaviors, including setup, validation, UI interactions, and related dialogs.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Main class managing the Item doctype form behaviors, including setup, refresh, validation, and attribute management.

methods.name: setup_queries
methods.description: Sets up query filters for various fields in the item form.

methods.name: toggle_attributes
methods.description: Controls display and editability of item attributes based on variant settings.

methods.name: show_single_variant_dialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to create a single item variant based on attributes.

methods.name: show_multiple_variants_dialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to create multiple item variants based on selected attribute values.

methods.name: show_modal_for_manufacturers
methods.description: Shows a modal dialog to input manufacturer details for creating a variant.

methods.name: make_dashboard
methods.description: Creates a stock dashboard for the item if applicable.

methods.name: edit_prices_button
methods.description: Adds a button to navigate to the Item Price list for editing prices.

methods.name: weight_to_validate
methods.description: Validates that weight units are specified if weight is entered.
